title: Establishment of predictive models for postoperative delirium in elderly patients after knee/hip surgery based on total bilirubin concentration: machine learning algorithms.
summary: Ten machine-learning models used clinical features including total bilirubin to predict postoperative delirium in older orthopedic patients; the best reported neural-network model is a retrospective prediction result.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s medicine dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
organization: Department of Anesthesiology, Qingdao Municipal Hospital, Qingdao, Shandong Province, China

evidence.tested: Ten machine-learning models used clinical features including total bilirubin to predict postoperative delirium in older orthopedic patients; the best reported neural-network model is a retrospective prediction result.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
